data.name: Ziqitza HealthCare Ltd.
data.about:
Incepted in 2005, Ziqitza HealthCare Ltd. (ZHL) is one of the leading players in India’s Emergency Medical Services (EMS) industry. It was set up by a group of young professionals, who identified the need for an organized and networked ambulance service system in India to effectively respond to all kinds of medical emergencies. Whether it’s an accident or a major ailment, the first few minutes are critical in saving a life. Recognizing this need and realizing the gap that existed in the Indian market, the founders began their journey to create the best emergency response service in India, at par with the capabilities & operations of 911 in the US, and 999 in the UK. Over the span of 16 years, ZHL has established a solid presence in the EMS sector of India. The company has grown exponentially, from being a start-up with 10 ambulances to a well-established corporate entity with a fleet of 3,022 ambulances across 18 states in the country and almost 10,000 employees. ZHL regularly partners with state governments and the National Health Mission (NHM) to operate the 108 ambulance service helpline for emergency medical services & 104 health helpline for health-related queries. With years of expertise in the pre-hospital segment and EMS outsourcing, ZHL has now taken the next step in healthcare by offering services for workplace health & safety. With the vision to become a ‘one-stop solution’ for corporate wellness and holistic healthcare, ZHL provides turnkey solutions including ambulance on site, wellness at workplace, telehealth services, medical rooms, doctor on site & occupational health centers. Top companies from E-com, Manufacturing, Insurance, IT, Real Estate & FMCG sectors have reposed their faith in ZHL to avail of its customized healthcare solutions.

data.name: BAI JERBAI WADIA HOSPITAL FOR CHILDREN - BJWHC
data.about:
Bai Jerbai Wadia Hospital for Children and Research Centre (BJWHC) is the first Pediatric Hospital established in India, meant exclusively to provide comprehensive healthcare to children with a variety of health problems in an affordable manner. The foundation stone for the hospital was laid on 7th March, 1928, when no large hospitals existing at the time had a Pediatric Department. Built in the memory of Bai Jerbai Wadia by her two sons, the late Sir Cusrow N Wadia and the late Sir Ness N Wadia, the 78 bedded hospital which included an Orthopedic Factory was declared open on 13th December, 1929, by the then Governor of Bombay, Sir Frederick Sykes. The Bombay Municipal Corporation has continuously and generously contributed to this cooperative endeavor from the time of inception. Dr. RN Cooper was the first Hon. Principal Medical Officer of the hospital. Pediatrics made a beginning in Mumbai as a specialty in 1928, when Dr. George Coelho, rightly called the Father of Indian Pediatrics, became the Superintendent of BJWHC.. Between 1929 – 1958 the BJWHC was the only hospital dedicated exclusively to children and imparted training to undergraduate students from G.S. Medical College. Known for its academic excellence, many senior pediatricians of today have been trained at BJWHC. BJWHC has been providing charitable services for past 85 years to the most vulnerable section of society – "the sick child". It has been serving not only as community clinic for common health needs of children, but also as a tertiary referral center, where complex cases are referred from various parts of the country for diagnostic workup and specialized treatment. Currently the 300 bedded BJWHC is manned by an expert team comprising of more than 60 pediatric specialists providing care for over 100,000 children on an outpatient basis, and around 10,000 children as inpatients annually and is also the nodal center for Clubfoot in Maharashtra

data.name: Holy Family Hospital, Bandra
data.about:
Holy Family Hospital, Mumbai, evolved purely out of the need to serve the complex and growing needs of Mumbai’s suburbs. What started as a private nursing home has since developed into a multi-specialty hospital and medical research centre under the stewardship of two religious congregations. The hospital’s humble beginnings date back to 1942, when Dr Austin Da Silva opened a 10-bed private nursing home called ‘Silverene’ in suburban Bandra. Over the next decade, the healthcare needs of suburban Mumbai grew manifold, and to fill the void for a professional hospital, ‘Silverene’ was handed over to the Medical Mission Sisters in 1953. The congregation expanded the nursing home to accommodate 22 beds and rechristened it as the ‘Holy Family Hospital’. The congregation embraced its new mission with zeal and set a fine tradition in community healthcare with a special emphasis on maternity care. The hospital thus grew from a local, need-based clinic to a modest institution that catered to the general medical needs of Mumbai’s extended suburbs. Over the next two and a half decades, the demographics of Mumbai’s suburbs changed dramatically. They became more complex and as the population grew, so did healthcare requirements.

In the vast tapestry of the healthcare industry, where expertise converges with empathy, a story unfolds — the extraordinary journey of Dr. Hidayat Khan, the visionary founder of Human Care Worldwide. With 19 years dedicated to healing hearts & transforming lives, Dr. Khan's story is a testament to the power of compassionate care that transcends borders. Dr. Khan's journey commenced in the quiet hum of hospital corridors as an ICU registrar intensivist in Mumbai. The pulse of life echoed through every heartbeat, sparking a deep calling within him. In 2001, driven by this inner compass, he founded Human Care Worldwide, not merely as a healthcare enterprise but as a legacy of compassionate care resonating globally. The pivotal year 2004 witnessed the birth of the first private ground ambulance in Mumbai, marking the inception of Human Care Cardiac & Air Ambulance. Dr. Khan's vision to redefine healthcare accessibility took flight, with the first Air Ambulance journeying from India to France. This marked the beginning of a transformative journey that would span continents and touch countless lives. Phase two unfolded in 2012, as Human Care took on the responsibility of serving Mumbai International Airport Limited's medical requirements, a milestone showcasing the brand's impact in critical healthcare scenarios. In 2018, Human Care achieved its first international flight to Dubai, establishing its first Strategic Business Unit in the city. The recent year, 2023, witnessed global expansion, with branches in Oman & Bangladesh, reaching over 150 countries and welcoming 250 new global clients. Dr. Khan emphasizes the collective journey, stating, "It is ‘our’ goal." As Human Care Worldwide celebrates 19 years, his commitment shines through, expressing gratitude for the support and trust of clients and partners. Here's to a bright future, where they will undoubtedly continue to shine as a force for healing for years to come.

The high failure rate of most weight loss programs is because they only focus on diet and exercise. Obesity is a complex health condition with several underlying metabolic factors that cause weight gain. Unless these are managed weight loss is a long, painful and demanding process. MediWt is a weight loss support program that helps in the identification and management of the health factors that make you fat. When combined with other weight loss methods like diet modification and exercise, it increases the speed and the success rate of weight loss. MediWt is created and managed by doctors and is based on medical research findings published in top global medical journals, recommendations of national and international medical associations. How Do We Do It? Step 1: We find out what is causing your weight gain Our protocol involves obesity-specific digital and laboratory diagnostic tests, multi-specialty evaluation. Many of these tests are innovative and are being patented* in the USA Step 2: We recommend therapy to add on to diet and exercise These are based on your diagnosis and could include supplements, exercise methods, and even prescription medicines. Everything you get is doctor recommended after a thorough personal evaluation. Step 3: We monitor the weight loss and adapt the therapy Once you get started with the therapy our artificial intelligence-based system digital monitor the changes and flex the therapy to keep the weight loss momentum. The Need: For too long patients have found it extremely challenging to lose weight as conventional weight loss programs have ignored many of the medical causes of obesity. We are correcting that situation by incorporating medical management as a part of the weight loss process.

data.name: DocsLink
data.about:
DocsLink offers a cloud-based, simple and secure telemedicine solution for doctors, enabling them to easily create their personal virtual room and start providing online consultations to their patients. The product has been designed keeping the doctor’s clinical workflow in mind and will give doctors more control to manage their online consultations. Each doctor or clinic gets to create their unique web link, during their onboarding process, which takes visitors to their virtual-clinic / virtual-consultation-room where doctors can choose customised templates to display their details such as – Name, Medical qualifications, Area of expertise, hospital/clinic logo and availability hours. Visitors can request appointments for online consultation as well as call the clinic or hospital for in person visits.

By bringing these advanced techniques back to Mumbai, he rapidly established himself as a pioneer in delivering world-class eye care, attracting patients from all corners of India and abroad. With 40 years of dedicated service, Ojas Eye Hospital has evolved into a global leader in modern ophthalmic care. Guided by Dr. Dedhia’s vision, the hospital is known for its highly skilled clinical team, cutting-edge technology, and unwavering commitment to a patient-first philosophy. These core values have made Ojas one of the most trusted names in eye care. Where We Stand Today Ojas Eye Hospital proudly operates three premier centers across Mumbai, located in Bandra (W) and Kandivali (E). Over the past four decades, we have provided comprehensive eye care to more than 500,000 patients, performing over 125,000 successful surgeries for individuals from 75+ countries, including the USA, UK, Canada, Poland, Dubai, Kenya, and Australia. data.about:
The Koita Centre for Digital Diabetology (KCDD) has been set up by Research Society for the Study of Diabetes in India (RSSDI) in partnership with Koita Foundation. RSSDI is the largest association of physicians dedicated to the care of people with diabetes in Asia, with over 13,000 members across 23 states in India. Koita Foundation is a leading NGO focused on accelerating Digital Health adoption. KCDD promotes the use of digital technologies and tools to improve Diabetes care, and facilitates research and innovation in diabetes. Key focus areas of KCDD include driving adoption of diabetes-specific Electronic Medical Records (EMR), digital health grants, digital health courses for doctors and healthcare personnel, patient education content, diabetes management apps, interoperability of patient information, remote tracking of patients, and use of consumer health applications and devices. In addition, KCDD supports the creation of large-scale data for diabetes research & registries, which are important for research and public health initiatives. KCDD also partner with hospitals, universities and research organizations to promote research and development in diabetes care.

Moved by the plight of poor section of the inhabitants of the area around Dahisar, a distant suburb (on the border of its outskirts) of Mumbai, due to lack of proper and affordable medical facilities in the area, Shri Nemji Karamshi Gangar, presently the Managing Trustee of the organisation, garnered support of various friends and like – thinking individuals to mobilise the funds for starting an affordable medical facility in the area. Very soon, with the dedicated efforts of Shri Nemji Karamshi Gangar and his team, and whole hearted financial and moral support of philanthropists and well wishers, a small but definite step was taken by establishing Shri K V O Jain Manav Kalyan Kendra, Dahisar in the year 1985. This trust started its activities by establishing PRINCE HEALTH CENTER in the year 1991 in Dahisar East. The objective of the said center was to provide cutting edge technological diagnostic facilities for all sections of the society at an affordable cost. It was the vision of the said founding team that the organisation should be run on a no – profit – no – loss basis but at the same time should be a self financing project. Thus the charges were provided at the lowest minimum possible to cover the cost of the diagnostic tests and at the same time to build up sufficient reserve to take care of wear and tear / obsolescence of the equipments. Presently the said center has become a landmark spot in Dahisar providing medical services to around 1000 patients every day. Visiting Honorary Doctors are also invited to attend the center to provide medical advice to the patients visiting the center for diagnostic reports. Around 135 Honorary doctors render their services on a weekly basis.
